rationale: The pain signal originates from a single HN thread with 21 upvotes and 11 comments tied to a specific PR controversy (1Password's $300K donation). This is episodic, event-driven switching intent rather than a recurring, persistent pain — the moment the controversy fades, so does the demand. Despite the presence of paying B2B customers (willingness-to-pay plausible by proxy), there is no evidence of 5 distinct pain quotes, no willingness-to-pay signal for a migration tool specifically, and no competitor charging for this service at scale, failing the minimum bar set in config/pain_validation.yaml.
